snippet.title: New Interface, Summons, Chat, Building Systems and more! | Building my Indie MMORPG - Dev-log #4
snippet.description:
Everything is still being tested and developed, nothing is final and there are a lot of bugs to be fixed.

In this dev-log #4 I present you the new Interface for Inventory and Asters. You can select the Light or Dark UI and it will change you're HUD/UI. Right now only Inventory and Summon UI have it.

Speaking in summons, the "Asters" are one of the main cores of the game. They're summons that help you in combat, have their own status and skills, gears etc. There is a CARD SYSTEM that will increase your Aster status. You can fuse two asters of the same name for a chance to increase their Star Level. Asters summoned will give its owner bonus attributes while in field.

I'm also implementing a Building System: 
- The player can find a Land and buy it with gold.
- When the land its yours, just start building by collecting material (Wood, Glass, Iron, Rock etc) in the world to craft them: from Empty houses to fully decorated ones.

The system above brings a lof of customization for player. Inside your house you'll have your wardrobe for the future Fashion system. Your personagel (account) vault, a bed to sleep when you go offline, some other social features with friends invited.

I'm polishing each one of these systems before I can start doing something else.

VFX and ANIMATIONS were removed so I can do it from scratch and smoothly later.
